additional_info.subject: 0442954 - ID0442954-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / R6 170002059] 2nd Connector Error: secc pilot is E CRM:00314000216
additional_info.body:
Good evening everyone,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0442954
for charger
MP/R6 170002059.
I have merged into this ticket also ticket number
ID0443212,
which was opened by regional Siemens for the same issue on the charger.
The ticket has been opened for outlet 2 out of order. I connected remotely via SSH, and saw that in the EcoG KF11 for outlet 2, the following error was present "could not configure local station for slac".
This is a known error, which could be solved with the new EcoG FW v1.4.11. For this reason, I updated the EcoG FW to 1.4.11 today.
After reboot, the outlet came back available, and the error is not present anymore, but I could not monitor any successful charging session.
Could you please monitor the station, and let me know if the issue on outlet 2 is solved?
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
Smart Infrastructure
eMobility Service Delivery
Expert Services
SI E CS SD ES
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
